{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuati residential space station''' was one of the facilities of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Orbital Array]] that constructed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was located in a ring of other installations that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. As implied by the name, this [[Space station/Legends|space station]] acted as the living space for the various [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] workers at the Orbital Array.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
